# Lunar Linux

> Lunar Linux is a source-based distribution: build your system exactly how you want it, with simple tools and a friendly community. Packages are built from source by the `lin` command, from modules in the moonbase.

## Documentation

- [Community](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/community/): Lunar Linux community resources, user experiences, and contributions
  - [User Reports and Success Stories](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/community/user-reports/): Real-world experiences installing and running Lunar Linux on various hardware
- [Development](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/development/): Developing for and contributing to Lunar Linux
  - [Module Basics](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/development/module-basics/): Understanding the structure and files that make up a Lunar Linux module
  - [Writing Modules](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/development/module-writing/): A walkthrough of creating a new module for the Lunar Linux moonbase, from DETAILS to a tested build
  - [Module Submission](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/development/module-submission/): How to update a module and submit new or updated modules to the official Lunar Linux moonbase
  - [Module Function Reference](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/development/module-functions/): The Lunar functions and variables available in module files, grouped by the file they are used in
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/faq/): Common questions and answers about Lunar Linux, installation, optimization, and package management
- [Guides and How-Tos](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/guides/): Collection of guides and tutorials for Lunar Linux
  - [Understanding Build Times](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/guides/build-times/): How long Lunar takes to compile things, measured on our build server, and how to make it faster
- [Installation](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/): Installing Lunar Linux on your system
  - [System Requirements](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/requirements/): Hardware and software requirements for installing Lunar Linux
  - [Installation Guide](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/installation-guide/): Step-by-step guide to installing Lunar Linux from the daily ISO
  - [Complete Installation Guide (1.6.5)](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/complete-install-guide/): Comprehensive step-by-step guide for installing Lunar Linux 1.6.5 from ISO
  - [Desktop Environments](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/desktop-environments/): Installing and configuring desktop environments and window managers on Lunar Linux
  - [XOrg 7 Setup Guide](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/xorg-setup/): Installing and configuring XOrg 7.x on Lunar Linux
  - [Advanced Installation Methods](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/advanced/): Alternative and advanced installation techniques for Lunar Linux
    - [Installing Without a CD Drive](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/advanced/no-cd-installation/): Alternative methods for installing Lunar Linux without using a CD-ROM drive
    - [Installing Without Network Access](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/advanced/no-network-installation/): How to install and update Lunar Linux without a fast or available network connection
    - [Software RAID Installation](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/advanced/software-raid/): Installing Lunar Linux on software RAID for improved performance and redundancy
    - [Kernel Command Line Parameters](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/advanced/kernel-parameters/): Configuring device node handling via bootloader kernel parameters
  - [Archived Installation Guides](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/archive/): Historical installation documentation for older Lunar Linux versions
    - [Lunar Linux Installation Guide (Version 1.5.0)](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/installation/archive/installation-1.5.0/): Historical installation guide for Lunar Linux 1.5.0 ISO (Archived)
- [Package Management](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/package-management/): Managing packages with Lunar's source-based package management system
  - [Lin Basics](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/package-management/lin-basics/): The everyday commands for installing, finding, updating and removing software on Lunar
  - [Moonbase](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/package-management/moonbase/): Understanding Lunar Linux's package repository structure and organization
- [System Administration](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/system-administration/): Administering your Lunar Linux system
- [Contributing to Documentation](https://demo.lunar-linux.org/pr-preview/pr-50/docs/contributing/): Guidelines for contributing to Lunar Linux documentation
